page.notes: Side-title IESVITARVM in the left margin is printed vertically; recorded as a margin note. Uncertain readings: "salutatiores" (marked [?]) and the lead word of XXXVII, read as "Vna" but possibly "Vina". Long s normalised to plain s throughout; u/v and i/j normalised per the rules. The printed "Infanabilis" was read as "Insanabilis" (long s). Reference "Actor" is partly obscured. Ornamental marks in the left margin (bullets and a small glyph) are not text and are omitted. Lines run to the bottom edge of the scan, and the final word "rum." is printed at the right edge.
